setupTasks.name: setup backend venv
setupTasks.command: cd Backend && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && pip install torch numpy pandas scikit-learn matplotlib networkx fastapi uvicorn[standard] pydantic pydantic-settings python-multipart python-jose[cryptography] passlib[bcrypt] httpx supabase openpyxl xlsxwriter reportlab aiofiles python-dotenv && (pip install torch-geometric || echo 'torch-geometric install skipped; backend will run with reduced ML features')

tasks.name: backend
tasks.command: cd Backend && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --http h11 --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips='*'
